hero.title: Microgravity Combustion: Prediction & Safety for Artemis & Mars
hero.body: NASA has gathered four decades of experimental data from the ISS and Cygnus spacecraft (Saffire, BASS, FLEX). StellarApp synthesizes, classifies and interprets this physics with AI to safeguard crews in pressurized lunar and Martian habitats.
